headline: Guests are happy overall; noise and repairs pull the score down most.

watch.label: Noise
watch.note: air-conditioner sound, thin walls, noisy corridor

watch.label: Repairs (A/C, hot water, bathroom)
watch.note: hot water turns hot and cold, A/C makes noise

actions.action: Log noise and repair complaints by room number
detail: Engineering logs A/C and hot-water problems by room number
Check whether a few rooms keep failing or the problem is general
actions.why: Noise and repairs are the bulk of low-score reviews; first separate individual rooms from the whole building.

actions.action: State breakfast and extra charges clearly on every platform
detail: Check the breakfast description on each platform's room page
Keep the charge wording before and after arrival consistent
actions.why: These complaints can be reduced by fixing the page wording, at low cost.

findings.title: Overall reputation is good; low scores concentrate on noise and repairs
findings.detail: Of the 160 reviews analysed, 27 are low-score.
evidence: Sample data, only to demonstrate the report layout
